GULLY CHASE ✳ TECHNOLOGY FOR JOYMADE FOR A GOOD TIME.NO SAMOSAS WERE HARMED.

QUICK GULLY GUIDE

Crime has never
been this silly.

01

Grab the gossip.

Walk to one of the three glowing treasures. Press E to pick it up. You can carry one at a time.

02

Bring it home.

Return to the green safehouse at the bottom left and press E to bank. Deliver all three before time runs out.

03

Keep it down.

Loot makes noise that attracts the cop. F spends 25 energy to hush it for 5 seconds. Q drops it. Chai restores energy.

04

Or be the cop.

Tag the chor three times to win. SPACE throws a short-range net with a 5-second cooldown. Watch the red noise rings!

TWO PEOPLE, ONE KEYBOARD.

Chor: WASD · Shift sprint · E grab/bank · Q drop · F hush.
Cop: Arrow keys · / sprint · Enter net. Tagging happens on contact.
Solo: WASD or arrows · Shift sprint · Space net as cop.

Bushes hide a quiet chor from distant cops. The trophy slows you down. Esc / P pauses. Touch controls support solo play. Local best scores stay on this browser.
